footnotes: From pre-tax income to net income to BKV: after $1.7M attributable to noncontrolling interests, $1.4M of preferred dividends.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue rose 73.6% to $1.0B in 2025. Operating income was $218M, up from a $155M loss.
Net income was $172M, or $1.98 per share, after a $143M loss a year earlier. Operating cash flow was $243M and free cash flow −$57.5M, versus $17.6M.
sources: BKV Corporation Form 10-K for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)
